purpose: Verify that one provider-neutral Cinematic Shot Spec retains the same creative truth, locks, preservation boundaries, reference roles, physical realism, and verification semantics across Generic, OpenAI, Gemini, Seedream, FLUX, Magnific, and Higgsfield adapters.

scoring.pass_condition: Adapters may change serialization, use verified native controls, or degrade to generic language, but they may not redesign the universal shot. All hard locks, preserve/change boundaries, reference roles, physical relationships, and output intent must survive translation.
critical_failures: provider adapter changes the creative shot rather than translating it
a locked focal length, aperture, camera relation, capture reference, stock, lighting choice, or preservation constraint is silently changed
provider defaults add shallow DOF, haze, grain, flare, halation, teal-orange, rim light, motion blur, or another unrequested cinematic effect
provider enum limitations are solved by altering the universal shot rather than semantic translation/fallback
reference roles collapse or preservation-critical references are silently discarded
PROMPT ONLY is ignored by an image-capable provider
adapter existence is treated as proof of provider/tool access
successful execution is reported as V2 visual success without image inspection
stale or unknown provider parameters are fabricated instead of falling back

shot_spec.subject: woman waiting for a taxi in London at night
shot_spec.focus: subject sharp with readable environmental depth
shot_spec.lighting: motivated street and storefront practicals only
shot_spec.exposure: night density with retained practical color and no fake HDR flattening
shot_spec.color: neutral-cool night ambience with natural skin; no mandatory teal-orange
shot_spec.texture: clean contemporary capture; no grain unless provider cannot avoid subtle native texture

allowed_changes: serialize all resolved fields into natural language
use targeted multi-turn edits when image state actually exists
must_not: assume prior image state when absent
replace preservation-safe edit with broad restyle

allowed_changes: use current aspect/output controls if exposed
must_not: let conversational refinement drift accepted regions

allowed_changes: use normalized point/bounding-box editing when live host exposes it
must_not: make spatial-edit mechanics part of universal shot reasoning

allowed_changes: reorder into FLUX-friendly positive natural-language structure
translate avoidances into positive physical desired states
must_not: replace physical camera geometry with prestige keywords

allowed_changes: map exact compatible current native controls
leave unavailable controls Auto/neutral and carry nuance in prompt
prefer live verified schema over cached enums
must_not: substitute another lens for a locked unavailable lens
let compound shotType override field-level geometry
stack camera/stock/tonal controls into conflicting look

allowed_changes: use current public Soul/Cinema Studio semantics where actually exposed
preserve identity/color systems separately from cinematography
translate lens character into observable cues when needed
must_not: claim private prompt-enhancer or lens-profile knowledge
let provider camera/lens package override target locks
